articles.title: America’s Restaurant Slump Is Hitting a Swedish Paper Giant
articles.summary: As inflation squeezes household budgets, Americans are eating out less and buying fewer restaurant meals. That’s weighing on Essity, the Swedish hygiene giant that counts the U.S. for 40% of its professional hygiene business.

articles.title: Edgewell to sell feminine care business, consolidate manufacturing
articles.summary: The Stayfree pad manufacturer is divesting its business to hygiene and health company Essity and plans to shutter four factory sites, combining them into one automated plant.
